name: Asian Tour
notes: The 2026 season is the 31st of the modern Asian Tour; the Wikipedia 2026 schedule table (fetched 25 Sep 2026) lists 17 official events including 2 cancelled International Series events (International Series India, International Series China); asiantour.com schedule pages are JavaScript-rendered and returned no table text.

On 21 July 2026 the Asian Tour left its LIV Golf partnership and joined the PGA Tour / DP World Tour strategic alliance with immediate effect; the DP World Tour returns to co-sanctioning Asian Tour events from 2027 (CBS Sports, 2026-07-21). AFP (via Philstar, 2026-07-22) reports the partnership runs until at least 2029 and that LIV Golf had bankrolled the International Series to the tune of $300m.

After the split, remaining events lost International Series event status (Wikipedia notes 'Tournament had International Series event status removed following the restructuring of LIV Golf after the Public Investment Fund's announcement of withdrawal of funding', citing Flushing It, 2026-08-15); the three late-season events (Link Hong Kong Open, BingoPlus Philippine Open, PIF Saudi International) carry an 'International Series [status removed]' footnote.

The International Series pages on internationalseries.com still describe the 2026 season as co-sanctioned by LIV Golf and the Asian Tour with a pathway to LIV Golf (fetched 25 Sep 2026); they may predate the July 2026 split - flagged on the matching issue.

Event-host shape: tournaments are recorded as clubs (sportId golf, leagueId asian-tour) following the dp-world-tour pattern; kits array is empty; tournament sponsors are recorded as clubId-null league-partner deals (org-partner shape).
